d:
Around the world, when the sun goes down, deadly dangers emerge for wild animals. In the African wilderness, a lion cub cries for his mother while a hyena gets closer and closer. In the Arabian Desert, a gecko realizes he’s not alone when the sand beneath his feet starts shifting. In Southern India, a praying mantis prays as an army of weaver ants march toward his arms and legs. Who will survive the horrors of tonight, and who will be dead by dawn?
